convert_extri_intri_to_pose_encoding: convert camera extrinsics and intrinsics tensors to a compact 9D pose encoding with translation, quaternion, and field of view
convert_pose_encoding_to_extri_intri: convert a 9D pose encoding tensor back to camera extrinsics and intrinsics matrices
encode_camera_pose_for_batch: encode a batch of camera poses from extrinsic and intrinsic tensors into compact BxSx9 pose encoding format
decode_pose_encoding_to_intrinsics: decode pose encoding tensors back to full intrinsics matrices with focal lengths and principal points
roundtrip_camera_pose_encoding: test roundtrip conversion of camera extrinsics and intrinsics to pose encoding and back to verify correctness
